Pitbull Attacks Couple in Patiala While Viewing Rental Property

A couple sustained severe injuries in Patiala, Punjab, after being attacked by a pitbull dog while viewing a rental property. The attack occurred in Ghuman Nagar. The woman suffered multiple deep wounds and underwent plastic surgery, while her husband also sustained bite wounds requiring stitches. CCTV footage captured the incident, showing residents attempting to fend off the dog. The incident has led to discussions about banning aggressive dog breeds.
